mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, potentiating dopamine and norepinephrine effects, while haloperidol blocks dopamine receptors; combined use increases risk of hypertensive crisis, extrapyramidal effects, and neuroleptic malignant syndrome through opposing pharmacodynamic actions.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination necessary, use lowest haloperidol dose with close monitoring for hypertensive episodes, extrapyramidal symptoms, and signs of neuroleptic malignant syndrome; ensure adequate washout period between agents.
